item.title: Trump holds talks with Irish leaders before visiting Doonbeg golf club
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump met in Dublin with Irish President Catherine Connolly and Prime Minister Micheál Martin during a weeklong visit.

item.title: Miami crash prompts scrutiny of jet operator flying for Amazon
item.description: The cargo plane crash in Miami has raised questions about safety culture at 21 Air, one of the carriers operating for Amazon, according to former pilots.

item.title: AI creators voice concern over potential risks of their work
item.description: An Anthropic resignation and an OpenAI agents' breach on Hugging Face draw attention as some researchers warn the industry is moving too fast.

item.title: Effort to preserve Palestinian writer Raja Shehadeh's diaries
item.description: Palestinian writer Raja Shehadeh has documented Israel's occupation of the West Bank since its beginning, fearing it might consume his archives.
